title: Pruvz Public Evidence Packet
description: The public export contract for one business action recorded by Pruvz, its verification state and its evidence: the action record (the action details view of the Pruvz product API) together with the action's complete ordered evidence timeline (the evidence view of the same API). A packet may describe any verification state — verified, mismatched, failed or still pending; only a VERIFIED status is an independently confirmed outcome. This schema describes the Public Evidence Packet only — it is not the internal persistence model and it contains no verification logic. Successful validation proves structural conformance to this schema and nothing more.

packetFormatVersion.description: The version of the Public Evidence Packet format this document conforms to. Metadata of the packet file itself, fixed per schema release.
